mapper.update: /* Risk01Mapper.mergeRistType */ INSERT INTO TB_RISK_TYPE ( CMPNY_CD , RISK_TYPE_CD , RISK_TYPE_NM , SITE_CD , PROCESS_CD , USE_YN , RISK_TYPE_DESC , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES( #{gvCmpnyCd} , IFNULL(#{riskTypeCd}, FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{gvCmpnyCd}, 'RISK_TYPE_CD')) , #{riskTypeNm} , NULLIF(#{siteCd}, '') , #{processCd} , IFNULL(#{useYn}, 'Y') , #{riskTypeDesc} , #{gvUserCd} , now() , #{gvUserCd} , now() ) AS NEW ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE RISK_TYPE_NM = NEW.RISK_TYPE_NM , USE_YN = IFNULL(NEW.USE_YN, 'Y') , UPDATE_NO = NEW.UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE = NOW()
